3. **Relative Speed Dynamics:**
   • **Same Direction:** Relative Speed (= |S_1 - S_2|); Time to cross (=  rac{L_1 + L_2}{S_1 - S_2}).
   • **Opposite Direction:** Relative Speed (= S_1 + S_2); Time to cross (=  rac{L_1 + L_2}{S_1 + S_2}).
   • **Boats & Streams:** Downstream (S_d = u + v); Upstream (S_u = u - v); Speed of Boat (u =  rac{S_d + S_u}{2}); Stream Speed (v =  rac{S_d - S_u}{2}).

### 🚀 3-Tier Worked Problem: Alternate Working Days in Time & Work

**Problem:** A can complete a task in 12 days, and B can complete it in 18 days. If they work on alternate days starting with A, in how many days will the work be completed?

* **Tier 1 (Fraction Method):** A’s daily work = ( rac{1}{12}), B’s daily work = ( rac{1}{18}). In a 2-day cycle, work done = ( rac{1}{12} +  rac{1}{18} =  rac{5}{36}). In 7 cycles (14 days), work done = (7 	imes  rac{5}{36} =  rac{35}{36}). Remaining work = ( rac{1}{36}). On day 15, A works: Time taken = ( rac{1/36}{1/12} =  rac{1}{3}) day. Total = (14 rac{1}{3}) days.
* **Tier 2 (LCM Units Method):** Total Work = (	ext{LCM}(12, 18) = 36	ext{ units}). Efficiency: (E_A =  rac{36}{12} = 3	ext{ units/day}); (E_B =  rac{36}{18} = 2	ext{ units/day}). In 2 days = (3 + 2 = 5	ext{ units}). Multiply by 7: In 14 days = (35	ext{ units}). Remaining = (1	ext{ unit}). On Day 15, A needs ( rac{1}{3}) day. Total = (14 rac{1}{3}) days.
* **Tier 3 (Mental Inspection Shortcut):** Recognize that the average rate is 2.5 units/day. (36 / 2.5 = 14.4) days. Since A starts first, cycle ends on Day 14 at 35 units; last unit requires exactly ( rac{1}{3}) day. Result: (14.33) days.

1. **Average Speed Trap:** If a person travels from A to B at speed (x) and returns at speed (y), Average Speed is NOT ( rac{x+y}{2}). It is the harmonic mean: (	ext{Avg Speed} =  rac{2xy}{x+y}).
2. **Train Passing a Platform vs Man:** Passing a platform requires distance (D = L_{	ext{train}} + L_{	ext{platform}}); passing a pole or standing person requires distance (D = L_{	ext{train}}).
